findings.title: Weekend/holiday comfort value kept as shown is dropped when the same save changes the weekday value
findings.claim: On the comfort options page, a weekend or holiday field left at the value the form shows is silently discarded whenever the same submit changes the weekday field its default is computed from, so the solve then plans that day with the new weekday value instead of the value on screen: 8 of 8 such fields lose the kept value, 0 of 8 in the null control.
findings.mechanism: config_flow._omit_unstored_computed drops an unstored _Computed field whose posted value equals row.default.of(current), with current the PRE-save entry; the reader (EntryConfig None -> OptimizationConfig._comfort_pair falls back to the weekday value) evaluates the fallback against the POST-save entry. Saving comfort_temp_day 22.5->21.0 with weekend shown 22.5 stores only comfort_temp_day=21.0, so Saturday plans 21.0.

evidence.unit: computed-default fields whose kept value is lost (of 8 same-page numeric)

perturbation.change: --perturb-merged: compute the _Computed default over {**current, **user_input} (the configuration the save produces)

findings.metric_definition: count of _Computed option rows with a same-page numeric source where entry src=A, submit src=B keeping field=A shown, gives effective field (EntryConfig, None->source) != A
findings.phenomenon_property: A value an options page posts for a field whose default is computed from other settings is stored whenever it differs from that default computed over the configuration the save produces (not the one it replaces).

findings.mechanism: house_thermal_mass maps to ThermalParameters.room_thermal_mass, read only by the single-zone dynamics (thermal_model.py simulate single-zone branch and envelope_thermal_mass's else-branch); two zones read upper/lower_floor_thermal_mass. Its sibling house_heat_loss_coefficient is gated when=_single_zone (R10-TWO-ZONE-HHL); this row has no gate, and its description ('In a floor-heated house the heavy floor and heated slab are counted separately ...') tells a floor-heated two-zone user it applies.

findings.title: Peak guard projects the window from current x elapsed, so it acts late on real peaks and holds back on non-peaks
findings.claim: With the peak guard saved on (threshold 2.0 kW from three recorded peaks, margin 0.5 kW) and a steady meter draw read once a minute through a 60-minute window, the guard's suppressing state disagrees with its description in 69 of 300 minute-samples over 5 draws: 0.8 and 1.2 kW (windows that cannot set a peak) are held back for 3 and 21 minutes, and 1.8, 3.0 and 9.0 kW (windows that will) are first held back at minutes 26, 16 and 6 instead of minute 1.
findings.mechanism: power_guard.project_window_mean returns (mean*elapsed + current_kw*elapsed)/window; its docstring (and the computed but unused `remaining`) says the remainder of the window continues at current_kw, i.e. (mean*elapsed + current_kw*remaining)/window. The projection is 0 at the window start, about half the draw early and about twice it near the end, so GuardState.update crosses threshold - margin at the wrong times.

evidence.unit: minute-samples whose suppressing state contradicts the documented rule, over 5 steady draws x 60 min

findings.metric_definition: sum over draws P in {0.8,1.2,1.8,3.0,9.0} kW of minutes m in 0..59 where suppressing != (P > 1.5 and m >= 1)
findings.phenomenon_property: The guard's projection of the open window's billed mean equals what the window averages if the current draw continues for the rest of it; with a steady draw it equals that draw from the first reading.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'project_window_mean' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py (its definition and its one caller, coordinator._on_power_event)
reproduction_steps: Options: Grid peak tariff on; Advanced > Fuse and peak guards: Peak guard on; a house power meter
month with three 2.0 kW peaks; meter steady at 1.2 kW
from minute ~39 of every hour the guard holds back hot water and nudges the curve down though the hour averages 1.2 kW
findings.proposed_fix_scope: power_guard.project_window_mean: weight current_kw by the remaining minutes; failing test on a steady draw below and above the line, null control guard off.
